name: Diploma Hotel Management
title: Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering
intro: The hotel management diploma roadmap: admission, food and service training, hotel internships and careers.

phases.title: Eligibility
phases.summary: Class 10 or 12 pass in any stream, with English.
points: Diploma and certificate courses are offered by Institutes of Hotel Management, polytechnics and private schools.
Good communication, grooming and customer-service attitude matter.
Check age and minimum marks for each institute.
Visit a hotel or restaurant to understand the work.

phases.title: Admission process
phases.summary: Merit lists, interviews and institute tests.
points: Apply on the institute portals.
Selection may include aptitude tests and an interview.
Compare training kitchens, restaurants and placement record.
Confirm admission with fee payment.

phases.title: Training modules
phases.summary: Food production, F&B service, front office and housekeeping.
points: Learn Food Production, Food and Beverage Service, Front Office and Housekeeping.
Study hygiene, food safety and hospitality communication.
Practise in training kitchens and restaurants.
Learn hotel software and cash handling basics.

phases.title: Industrial training
phases.summary: Paid training in hotels or restaurants.
points: Complete several months of training in partner hotels.
Rotate across departments and receive evaluation.
Develop guest-handling and teamwork.
Many hotels offer jobs to trainees.

phases.title: Careers and upgrade
phases.summary: Hotels, restaurants, cruise ships and entrepreneurship.
points: Roles: commis chef, F&B service associate, front office associate and housekeeping associate.
Employers: hotels, resorts, airlines catering, cruise lines and hospitals.
Upgrade: BHM or BBA in hospitality.
Start a cafe or catering business after experience.
